question: Who among the following is India’s only publicly well-known woman Shehnai player?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bageshwari Qamar.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• A third-generation artist, Delhi's **Bageshwari Qamar** stormed the male bastion of shehnai playing at a young age. 
 
• At six,** Bageshwari Qamar** couldn't have been much taller than the **shehnai she held in her hand** when she walked up to her father with a **nervous plea.**
 
• The first woman shehnai wadak of India is **Bageshwari Qamar**.
 
• Renowned **Guru Ustad Bismillah khan** taught her.
 
• She made her** debut in the year 1983** and was crowned as** “Shehnai Queen”** at Chandigarh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gauhar Jaan** was an Indian singer and dancer from Kolkata.​ 
 
• **Gauhar Jaan** is known as** "the Gramophone girl"** and **"the first recording superstar of India".**
 
• **Binodini Dasi**, also known as Notee Binodini, was an Indian Bengali actress and thespian.
 
• **Rasoolan Bai **was a leading Indian Hindustani classical music vocal musician. Belonging to the Benaras gharana.
